registry: French Legal, Statutory, Municipal and Regulatory Primary Sources (2026 Archive)

snapshots.documentTitle: Loi n° 70-9 du 2 janvier 1970 réglementant les conditions d'exercice des activités relatives à certaines opérations portant sur les immeubles et les fonds de commerce
applicabilityConditions: Regulated real estate brokerage, intermediation, and search mandates (mandat de recherche) require a Carte professionnelle T.
Non-intermediated advisory and research services that hold no listing inventory and do not broker transactions or receive seller commissions are distinct from regulated brokerage.

snapshots.documentTitle: Code de la construction et de l'habitation - Article L271-1
applicabilityConditions: Non-professional purchasers acquiring residential property have a 10-day statutory cooling-off period (délai de rétractation) starting the day after notification of the compromis de vente.

snapshots.documentTitle: Code de la construction et de l'habitation - Article L126-28-1 et L173-1-1 (DPE et audit énergétique)
snapshots.documentVersion: Loi Climat et Résilience n° 2021-1104 / Décret n° 2022-1143 / Décret n° 2023-796
applicabilityConditions: Energy audit prior to sale applies strictly to single-ownership residential buildings/dwellings (monopropriété or detached houses): class F and G from 1 April 2023, class E from 1 January 2025, class D from 1 January 2034.
Individual co-ownership apartments are excluded from the pre-sale energy audit obligation.
Rental prohibition timetable for energy decence: G+ from 2023, G from 2025, F from 2028, E from 2034.

snapshots.documentTitle: Code général des impôts - Articles 964, 965 et 977 (Impôt sur la fortune immobilière)
snapshots.documentVersion: Loi de finances pour 2018 consolidée au 01/01/2026
applicabilityConditions: IFI threshold is 1,300,000 EUR of net taxable real estate wealth as of 1 January.
Progressive tax rate starts from 800,000 EUR at 0.5% once the 1,300,000 EUR threshold is exceeded.

snapshots.documentTitle: Plan Local d'Urbanisme de Chamonix-Mont-Blanc - Règlement et servitudes de mixité sociale
snapshots.articleOrSection: Règlement d'urbanisme, dispositions générales et zones U/AU
applicabilityConditions: 25% social-housing mix quota applies to residential construction or major rehabilitation operations of at least 500 m2 floor area (surface de plancher) in designated constructible zones (U and AU).
Permanent-housing servitudes apply in designated sectors to preserve principal residences.

snapshots.documentTitle: Délibération du Conseil Municipal de Chamonix-Mont-Blanc sur les meublés de tourisme
applicabilityConditions: Mandatory 13-digit registration number for all short-term rental listings.
Primary residences capped at 90 days per calendar year.
Natural persons restricted to one secondary-residence temporary authorization without compensation for 3 years; additional units require commercial-to-residential compensation.

snapshots.documentTitle: Plan de Prévention des Risques Naturels (PPRN) - Vallée de Chamonix-Mont-Blanc
applicabilityConditions: Parcel-level natural hazard zoning: Red zone (strict inconstructibility), Blue zone (constructible under technical prescriptions), White zone (no identified hazard).
Covers avalanches, torrential flooding, and slope movements.

snapshots.documentTitle: Rapport public thématique : Les stations de ski face au changement climatique
applicabilityConditions: High-altitude ski stations vulnerability, aging thermal-sieve holiday co-ownerships, adaptation capex, and diversification recommendations.

snapshots.documentTitle: Demandes de Valeurs Foncières (DVF) - Transactions immobilières publiées
applicabilityConditions: Covers 5 rolling years of recorded notarized real property transactions at net selling price.
